description:
AcmeCorp's IT team is experiencing slow DNS propagation after making DNS changes. Modify the DNS zone parameters for the 'acmecorp.test' domain in Virtualmin to speed up propagation.

Using the Virtualmin web interface, make the following changes to the acmecorp.test DNS zone:

1. Set the Default Time-To-Live (TTL) for the zone to 300 seconds (5 minutes)
2. Set the SOA Refresh interval to 3600 seconds (1 hour)
3. Set the SOA Retry interval to 600 seconds (10 minutes)
4. Set the SOA Expiry time to 604800 seconds (7 days)
5. Set the SOA Minimum (negative caching) TTL to 300 seconds (5 minutes)

These settings are found in the DNS Records section for the acmecorp.test virtual server (look for 'Zone Options' or 'SOA Record'). Make sure to save all changes and apply the configuration.

Note: Enter all values as plain numbers in seconds (e.g., 300, not '5m').
